plan.title: Auction floor quantity exceeds total quantity

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Enable floor quantity validation for the test company.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation.
Change the event type to Auction.
Select a reverse buy-auction template so the pricing sheet is available.
Add the specified product with total quantity 10.
Complete the pricing sheet fields required before scheduling and publishing.
Set the first line's delivery location.

args.goal: On the auction create screen, set the first line's Floor Quantity to 15 while its total quantity remains 10, and stop with the invalid floor quantity visible

steps.note: Set the floor quantity, which has no dedicated catalog step.
Add two available QA vendors as participants.
Commit the default Start now and 30-minute schedule.

args.because: Floor Quantity cannot be greater than the Total Quantity
